company_description: NTN makes mechanical friction bear-able. The company manufactures metal and plastic bearings (from one millimeter to five meters in diameter) for use in almost any machine or mechanical system, including automobiles, jet engines, stereos, computers, and household appliances. NTN also makes precision processing and automated production equipment used in the high-tech industry, including CD inspection and LCD repair systems. NTN's automated production equipment includes bearings, spindles, and positioning tables. NTN also supplies the automobile industry with constant velocity joints (CVJ) that are used in four-wheel drive and independent suspension vehicles. Asia represents the company's largest market.

title: Engineer Trainee
description: Position: Engineer Trainee (Vibration & Dynamic Balancing) Job Type: Full-Time Experience: 0–3 Years Qualification: ITI/ Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering Location: Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai Salary: ₹1.8 – ₹2.15 LPA About the Role We are looking for a Mechanical Engineer who is interested in rotating machinery, vibration analysis, and field engineering. The selected candidate will work closely with experienced engineers on vibration measurement, analysis, and In-Situ Dynamic Balancing of rotating equipment at customer locations. This is an excellent opportunity for fresh graduates and early-career engineers to develop hands-on expertise in rotating machinery and industrial troubleshooting. Support measurements, troubleshooting, and equipment testing. Prepare technical datasheets, service reports, and balancing reports. Communicate with customers regarding technical clarifications and reports. Maintain accurate records of measurements and project documentation. Follow customer-site safety procedures and company guidelines. Travel to customer locations for project execution as required. Required Skills Basic understanding of rotating machinery and mechanical systems. Interest in Vibration Analysis, Condition Monitoring, and Dynamic Balancing. Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, and PDF documentation. Good communication and technical-reporting skills. Salary - 15k to 20K (Based on Performance salary will increase) Location - Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai Office timing - 9.30 AM to 6.30 PM Required Skills · Basic understanding of rotating machinery and mechanical systems. · Interest in Vibration Analysis, Condition Monitoring, and Dynamic Balancing. · Working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, and PDF documentation. · Willingness to travel and work at industrial/customer sites. · Good communication and technical-reporting skills. Why Join Us? · Opportunity for professional growth in Condition Monitoring and Predictive Maintenance. · Develop field-engineering and technical-reporting skills. · Gain hands-on experience with rotating machinery and vibration analysis. · Get exposure to real industrial equipment and customer projects. · Learn In-Situ Dynamic Balancing from experienced engineers. Who Can Apply? Fresher’s and candidates with 0–3 years of relevant experience in Mechanical Engineering, rotating equipment, vibration analysis, condition monitoring, or field service engineering are encouraged to apply. Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per year Benefits: Health insurance Life insurance Provident Fund Ability to commute/relocate: Thiruvanmiyur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu: Reliably commute or willing to relocate with an employer-provided relocation package (Required) Education: Diploma (Required) Willingness to travel: 75% (Required) Work Location: In person
